sections.title: Morning Shift (06:35 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 4x Keys, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 1x Ops Phone.
Arrived at office and completed debrief. Gearing up.
Commencing patrol. Heading towards Aotea Square with welfare checks on businesses along the way.
Queen Street Starbucks, Localito, McDonald’s, and 77 Convenience Store all clear. Heading to Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Square. Commencing sweep.
Area all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Heading up Wellesley Street towards Federal Street.
Sky Tower area, 77 Convenience Stores, Eighty Fed, and News Agency Store all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Heading towards St Patrick’s Cathedral Church. Commencing sweep of the area.
Area all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Arrived at Lower Albert Street. Commercial Bay all clear. Standing by for security presence. Britomart McDonald’s all clear.
Fort Lane, Fort Street, Coffee Club, Jo & Joe, Pocket Park, 77 Convenience Store, and Wilson Carpark all clear. Heading to check Gore Street.
Tribe and Auckland Harbour Suites all clear. Standing by for security presence.
High Street all clear. Heading towards Chancery Square via Kitchener Street.
Chancery Square all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Lorne Street and the library all clear. Heading towards Queen Street.
Businesses from Timezone to OPSM checked, and Chemist Warehouse. No issues. Standing by for security presence.
Businesses from Kathmandu to Q Convenience Store all clear. Heading towards Britomart McDonald’s.
Britomart McDonald’s all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Gore Street and Wilson Carpark all clear. Standing by.
Vulcan Lane all clear. Heading on Queen Street.
Queen Street all clear towards Aotea Square.
Welfare check on McDonald’s Queen Street, Localito, and Footlocker all clear.
Heading back to HQ for lunch break.
At HQ for lunch break. Standing by for calls.
Received a call from Canterbury Arcade about a vagrant inside. Responding now.
Arrived at the arcade; vagrant had left. No issues.
Heading back to HQ for shift handover.
At HQ. Standing by for calls.
Shift handover completed to afternoon shift.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 4x Keys, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 1x Ops Phone.
Ops phone charging (battery at 8%). Standing by at office for calls.
Commencing patrol on Queen Street towards Aotea Square. Welfare check on McDonald’s Queen Street, Footlocker, and Localito all clear.
Aotea Square full sweep all clear. Standing by for calls.
Response call from 35 High Street regarding a trespassed vagrant loitering on the property. Heading over; informed the Police had been called.
Arrived at the store; vagrant spotted sitting on the stairs of 35 High Street. A 2nd verbal trespass was served and the Police arrived. Standing by to ensure no escalation.
No further issues; the vagrant at 35 High Street has been arrested (footage attached). Resuming patrol on High Street towards Britomart.
Full sweep on Gore/Fort and Tyler Street completed. No issues. TK Square all clear.
Commercial Bay all clear, including the bus interchange. Standing by at TK Square for calls, a bit longer than usual due to a large group of delinquents on bikes at TK Square.
Welfare check McDonald’s Britomart all clear.
Heading on Queen Street towards Aotea Square.
Queen Street all clear. Heading to Darby Street. Going to HQ for a quick bathroom break.
Elliott Stables and Jungle 8 welfare check all clear. Standing by for calls.
Heading to HQ as one guard signs off soon.
One guard signs off; relieving guards on duty.
One guard rolling over the afternoon shift. Standing by at office as Ops phone is charging.
Received a call from Vulcan Lane about a female vagrant bothering customers around the restaurants. Heading there now.
Arrived at Vulcan Lane; vagrant moved off the lane to across the road. Standing by so she does not return to bother the patrons. Photos of female vagrant attached at end of shift.
Heading back to HQ as one guard is signing off now.
At HQ on standby until second guard starts at 10pm.
Second guard has arrived. Continuing patrols.
Awaiting 3rd guard to arrive so we can stay out and patrol. Charging Ops phone.
3rd guard arrived. Heading down Queen Street toward Take 10 (request from Nix). Handover complete.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment handover: 2x Keytags, 1x Ops Phone, 1x Charger, 2x Body Cameras, 2x Vests, 2x Radios, keys for doors.
Approached by a member of the public asking for directions to the nearest open club; successfully guided them to the closest location.
Full sweep of lower Queen Street. Showing presence at Britomart.
Welfare check at Reign & Pour. All clear.
Take 10 guard and area all clear.
Received a call from fellow authorities requesting standby at Reign & Pour due to a big event and a lot of alcohol seen in the line.
Arrived at destination. Standing by, minimising risk of issues and making it safe for the public.
Removed alcohol from a male individual.
Removed alcohol from a group of delinquents walking by.
Removed alcohol from a group of minors walking by.
Removed alcohol from a female individual. No issues.
Received a response call from Britomart McDonald’s of a female vagrant sleeping and throwing up inside.
Arrived at the response location; the female vagrant was not seen inside and had already left the area. Standing by, showing presence.
Britomart McDonald’s manager requested removal of a male vagrant causing disturbance to others. Removed the male vagrant off premises.
Bar101 all clear. Heading down to Reign & Pour to standby.
Arrived at Reign & Pour. Standing by, showing presence.
Received a call from manager team (Hasi) that all customers will be escorted out at 03:00; requested we direct traffic outside.
Everyone removed out of the event. All clear.
Full sweep of lower Britomart, McDonald’s, and guard. All clear.
Large group of individuals at Britomart in an aggressive altercation with another large group. Standing by, showing presence until clear.
Check on Darby Street and Elliott Street. All clear.
Patrolling up Victoria Street. All clear.
Welfare check on 77 Convenience Store. All clear.
Patrolling Federal Street towards Wyndham Street. All clear.
Patrolling down Wyndham Street towards Queen Street. All clear.
Welfare check on Q Convenience Store and Customs Mart. All clear.
Patrolling Fort Lane, Fort Street, and the bottom of High Street. All clear.
Welfare check on High Street Supermarket. All clear.
Full sweep around Chancery Square and Freyberg Square. All clear. Heading back to HQ.
Handover to morning shift. Night shift concluded.
